bible.summary: Boss's office: tiled ceiling with light panels, framed certificate, shelf of binders, sales chart on the wall (line dips and shoots up), calendar, wall clock, desk at the back left with a computer, keyboard, desk phone, stack of folders, mug and a gold name plate, the boss's black office chair right of the desk (desk), window with blinds, water cooler and radiator under it, visitor's chair on a rug in the middle plane (visitor), potted plant. Variants: TV studio, police station, bank/government office.

variants.change: TV studio: dark studio with acoustic wall panels, a lighting truss with spotlights, a coloured LED backdrop with a big glowing circle ringed with bulbs and a news ticker, a red 'on air' lamp, studio lights on stands at both edges, cables on the glossy floor; a small curved desk with a microphone, papers and mugs in the middle (desk — standing presenter), the host's office chair left of it (host) with a prompter monitor, the guest's armchair right of it (guest).

Police station: cork board with wanted posters linked by red thread, clock, height chart on the wall for mugshots, handcuffs on a hook; the duty desk with a computer, a lamp, a radio, papers and a box of doughnuts stands IN FRONT of the officer — the officer sits behind it (desk, hidden to the chest); a stool for the detainee in front of the desk on the left (suspect, middle plane); visitors stand in front (left, center, right); a barred cell door on the right with a bunk and a small barred window inside and keys hanging by it (cell). Things put down on the desk lie on it.

Bank / government office: marble wall, exchange-rate boards and a clock above; a counter with a glass partition and three numbered teller windows runs across the whole room IN FRONT of the staff — tellers/clerks stand behind it, seen through the glass and hidden to the waist (teller-1 left, teller-2 = desk middle, teller-3 right); clients stand in front of the windows (window-1, window-2 = window, window-3; center, left); stamps, a pen on a chain, a bell, forms and a small plant on the counter (things put down lie on it); queue rope on the left (queue), three waiting chairs in the middle plane on the right (wait-1…wait-3).

bible.prompt: boss office, big desk with computer and papers, office chair, potted plant, window with blinds
